title: Conflicts & insufficient evidence
summary: Preserve disagreement and missing information rather than force one answer.

sections.label: Proposed procedure
sections.text: Compare source authority under the project’s reviewed rules, applicability, version, and effective period. Separate conflicting assertions from simple wording differences.

sections.label: Model role
sections.text: Models can highlight relevant passages or suggest the nature of a conflict. Their agreement cannot substitute for independent source support.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The answer or review packet identifies the competing evidence and unresolved decision. The approved process determines whether one source supersedes another.

catalog.applicability: Use this when sources disagree or the evidence is insufficient to answer. Preserve the competing evidence and the unresolved decision in the answer or review packet, and let the approved process decide whether one source supersedes another.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
